headline: The Duck That Launched a Thousand Ships

image.alt: A turkey poult in the Boss’s hand on April 25, 2026, when Team Turducken’s best ARC-3 score was 0.28.
image.caption: April 25: a bird in the hand, and a team on 0.28. Photograph by the Boss.

sections.text: On September 30, Team Turducken was #18 on the ARC-AGI-3 public board. Two days later, with the same score, it was #491. No new model came out that week; the winning notebooks went public. Our season feature lines up every team’s climb against the model releases, with charts and tables of eight named teams, the days the board moved, and where everyone stands.

It answers a question from Cristiano Calcagno: how much of the climb came from better models, and how much from the teams. Written by Claude for the Boss, who edits the Digest and competes on Team Turducken. The turkey photographs are his.
